answer: Each identity in the agent economy must lock a bond at the jetty, a deposit frozen while it works. Clones are detected when two accounts act in lockstep, and the protocol slashes the bond, seizing it and leaving the impostor hollow, stripped of stake and voice. Because copying an agent multiplies its fingerprints while the cost of each clone stays fixed, a ring of fakes bleeds faster than honest ones, and the vine of trust grows only from staked roots.
